architecture.pattern: connector registry plus public-RPC typed scanner, dynamic quote bridge, and private exact-simulation execution gate
architecture.isolation_boundaries: the scanner emits typed candidates and non-executable intents; the dynamic bridge requires route evidence and fork-proven capability; the executor alone signs and broadcasts through a private relay
execution_flow: validate environment configuration and risk policy
index finalized protocol events and validate live scanner candidates without a wallet
transform typed candidates plus block-bound quotes into executor-ready opportunities
build and simulate every permitted allocation tier
repeat exact preflight and broadcast through the verified executor and private relay

test_criteria: configuration defaults and validation are covered
every tier is simulated before selection
an invalid split allocation cannot broadcast
the final executor adapter preflights immediately before send
scan mode rejects execution flags and never constructs a wallet client
scan output distinguishes Balancer callback loans from Uniswap v4 unlock delta settlement
dynamic close-factor, capability, quote-freshness, and memory-redaction behavior are covered
